title: Spec Workflow Deps Analysis (Structured)
description: Machine-readable counterpart to .rddf/state/.deps-output.md. Consumed by the iteration.json sync hook (deps.md Step 6) and any future planning tooling. Stored at .rddf/state/deps-analysis.json.

version.description: Schema version. Currently 1. Bumping this is a breaking change for consumers.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the analysis was generated.

fallback.description: True when deps ran in static 3-axis mode only (AI subagent unavailable). When true, consumers should treat any AI-only fields as empty.

execution_order.description: Recommended execution order. Changes at the same parallel_group may run together; the order in this list is the topological sort with parallel groups flattened to a sequence.

changes.description: Per-change analysis results. Keyed by change name.

name.description: OpenSpec change name (directory name under openspec/changes/).

phase.description: Roadmap phase from roadmap-meta.yaml. Null in compat mode.

category.description: Roadmap category from roadmap-meta.yaml. Null in compat mode.

status.description: Lifecycle status from deps perspective. Distinct from iteration.json's status (which is propose/execute/archive). ready = no hard blockers; blocked_by = waiting on another change; prerequisite = this change blocks others; conflict = has file-level conflicts.

blocker.description: Name of the change that hard-blocks this one. Null when status is not blocked_by.

blocks.description: Names of changes that this change hard-blocks (reverse direction of blocker).

parallel_group.description: Topological layer. 0 = can start immediately (no deps); 1 = depends on wave 0; N = depends on wave N-1. Changes in the same wave can run in parallel.

conflicts.description: Change names with file-level conflicts (intersection of in-scope files).

confidence.description: high = static 3-axis evidence; low = AI subagent inferred only. Consumers should require 'high' for hard decisions (e.g. parallel-group assignment).

recommendation.description: Human-readable execution hint (e.g. '第 1 优先', '等 v2-loop-engine 完成后').
